title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Trial of Dispute Cases concerning New Plant Varieties

articles.content_en: Article 2: When the People's Court examines, according to law, a prosecution involving new plant variety rights brought by a party, it shall accept the case according to law, provided that the prosecution meets the conditions for prosecution of a civil case or an administrative case prescribed in Article 119 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 49 of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.

Article 3: The cases in categories 1 to 5 enumerated in Article 1 of this Interpretation shall be tried by the Beijing Intellectual Property Court as the first-instance People's Court; the cases in categories 6 to 18 shall be tried by the intellectual property courts, the intermediate people's courts at the localities where the people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government are located, and the intermediate people's courts designated by the Supreme People's Court as the first-instance People's Courts.
Where a party refuses to accept a first-instance judgment or ruling in a civil or administrative case involving a new plant variety dispute and files an appeal, the case shall be tried by the Supreme People's Court.

Article 4: In a civil case involving infringement of new plant variety rights over which the jurisdiction of a People's Court is determined on the basis of the place of the infringing act, the so-called place of the infringing act refers to the place where the propagating material of the authorized new plant variety is produced, propagated, or sold without the permission of the owner of the variety right, or the place where the propagating material of the authorized variety is repeatedly used for commercial purposes to produce the propagating material of another variety.

Article 5: With respect to administrative dispute cases concerning review of rejection of new plant variety applications and administrative dispute cases concerning invalidation or renaming of new plant variety rights, the new plant variety approval authority shall be the defendant; with respect to dispute cases concerning compulsory licensing of new plant varieties, the new plant variety approval authority shall be the defendant; with respect to dispute cases concerning royalties for compulsory licensing, the defendant shall be determined according to the matters requested by the plaintiff and the parties prosecuted.

Article 6: Where, in a case involving infringement of new plant variety rights tried by a People's Court, the defendant, during the period for filing a defense, requests the new plant variety approval authority to declare the new plant variety right invalid, the People's Court generally shall not suspend the litigation.
